title: calendars-server: Calendar name/description localizable; coordinate with JMAP-lehj
description:
jmap-calendars-server (with calendars-types): Calendar `name` and `description` are localizable, per draft section "JMAP Calendars" (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars is unpublished; see decision .1(i)).
- ParticipantIdentity is excluded.
- CalendarEvent keeps JSCalendar locale/localizations; `language` on CalendarEvent/get is invalidArguments.
Coordinate with JMAP-lehj (-34 sync) so the two don't conflict on Calendar.
notes:
Design: docs/design/updates.md (final 2026-11-15, decisions 27-31). Ship behind the same opt-in after JMAP-lehj lands (decision 31/Q9).
From .12 (decision 32): add SessionClient::with_i18n to jmap-calendars-client (field i18n: Option<I18nSetting>, call_internal adds the URI, add_language in Calendar/get), same as mail/contacts/sharing clients.
